subject: Request: pilot runway credit & extension — OrbitAI integration delay
messages:
From: Alex Palmer <alex@orbitai.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot paused — asking for a short extension and credits

Hi Logan,

Quick update from our engineering side: the adapter we were building to pull customer transaction data into Redwood hit an unexpected schema mismatch when we started end-to-end testing yesterday. The ops team is on it but they estimate another 7–10 business days to get the connector stable. That effectively pauses our pilot — we can’t run the full prompt/embedding workflows until that’s cleared.

Given that, could Redwood extend the pilot window by two weeks and top up our sandbox credits so our PMs and data scientists still have runway once integration is unblocked? We’re at the point where a little breathing room would preserve momentum for the deal.

Attached is the integration error log that the eng lead sent over. Also including our updated PO intent (po-request-orbitai.pdf) so procurement is aligned once we move forward.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Alex Palmer
VP, Product
OrbitAI
(Attachment: integration-errors.log)
(Attachment: po-request-orbitai.pdf)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Palmer <alex@orbitai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot paused — asking for a short extension and credits

Alex — thanks for the heads up and for sending the log. Sorry to hear about the schema mismatch slowing you down. We’d love to keep OrbitAI’s momentum going.

I’m looping in Marissa (Customer Success) to coordinate the sandbox top-up and Aditya (my manager) for final approval on the promo. Can you confirm the amount of token credit you’re requesting and whether two weeks is sufficient? Also, any ETA on a testable slice we can try sooner (e.g., a trimmed schema)?

Proposed path:
- Internal approval for a one-time sandbox credit (suggested: 75k tokens)
- Extend pilot by 14 calendar days from the current end date
- Marissa to schedule a lightweight QA window once you have the trimmed schema so we can validate quickly and avoid another full pause

I’ll send a short approval request to Aditya now.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment referenced: integration-errors.log)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot paused — asking for a short extension and credits

Logan / Marissa — reviewed OrbitAI’s request and the attached error log. We can approve a limited make-good for pilots in situations like this, subject to the following conditions:

1) Credit cap: 75,000 tokens, one-time top-up to the sandbox.
2) Extension: 14 calendar days from current pilot end date.
3) Engineering check-in: OrbitAI must provide the trimmed-schema test artifact or a staging endpoint within 10 business days, and Marissa will validate within 48 hours of delivery.
4) PO acknowledgement: procurement doc received — legal will not require additional amendments for the promo but finance needs the PO for bookkeeping.

If OrbitAI can meet the engineering check-in timeline we’ll proceed. Marissa, please confirm you can run the QA validation and that CS will own the handoff once the schema slice is available. Logan, once I get confirmation I’ll route the promo code to finance to apply the credits.

– Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Palmer <alex@orbitai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot paused — asking for a short extension and credits

Alex — good news: Aditya has provisionally approved a one-time 75,000-token sandbox credit and a 14-day extension, contingent on the lightweight engineering check described below. We’ve put the conditions in writing so both sides are aligned.

Next steps for OrbitAI (requested):
- Provide the trimmed-schema test artifact or a staging endpoint by EOD next Friday (2026-12-10).
- Confirm the exact current pilot end date so we can calculate the extension window.
- Send a quick note from procurement acknowledging the PO intent (we have the PDF but need a short PO confirmation email to attach to the finance record).

Marissa will run the 48-hour QA validation once you provide the artifact and will coordinate the post-unblock smoke test. I’ll follow up with the promo code once finance applies the credit (should be within 1 business day of approval).

Would you like me to schedule a 15-min sync tomorrow to align timelines?

Thanks — we want to keep OrbitAI in the pilot funnel.

Best,
Logan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Palmer <alex@orbitai.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot paused — asking for a short extension and credits

Logan / Marissa — this is fantastic, thank you. We’ll aim to deliver the trimmed-schema artifact by 2026-12-09 (a day ahead of your ask) and will send a PO confirmation email this afternoon to satisfy finance. Two weeks extension sounds right.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I’ll keep you posted if anything changes. If helpful we can take the 15-min sync.

Alex
VP, Product
OrbitAI
(Attachment: integration-errors.log)
